entries.title: II Corinthians 6:1
segments: And working together [with him] we entreat also that ye receive not the grace of God in vain

entries.title: II Corinthians 6:2
segments: (for he saith, At an acceptable time I hearkened unto thee, And in a day of salvation did I succor thee: behold, now is the acceptable time; behold, now is the day of salvation):

entries.title: II Corinthians 6:3
segments: giving no occasion of stumbling in anything, that our ministration be not blamed;

entries.title: II Corinthians 6:4
segments: but in everything commending ourselves, as ministers of God, in much patience, in afflictions, in necessities, in distresses,

entries.title: II Corinthians 6:5
segments: in stripes, in imprisonments, in tumults, in labors, in watchings, in fastings;

entries.title: II Corinthians 6:6
segments: in pureness, in knowledge, in long suffering, in kindness, in the Holy Spirit, in love unfeigned,

entries.title: II Corinthians 6:7
segments: in the word of truth, in the power of God; by the armor of righteousness on the right hand and on the left,

entries.title: II Corinthians 6:8
segments: by glory and dishonor, by evil report and good report; as deceivers, and [yet] true;

entries.title: II Corinthians 6:9
segments: as unknown, and [yet] well known; as dying, and behold, we live; as chastened, and not killed;

entries.title: II Corinthians 6:10
segments: as sorrowful, yet always rejoicing; as poor, yet making many rich; as having nothing, and [yet] possessing all things.

entries.title: II Corinthians 6:11
segments: Our mouth is open unto you, O Corinthians, our heart is enlarged.

entries.title: II Corinthians 6:12
segments: Ye are not straitened in us, but ye are straitened in your own affections.

entries.title: II Corinthians 6:13
segments: Now for a recompense in like kind (I speak as unto [my] children), be ye also enlarged.

entries.title: II Corinthians 6:14
segments: Be not unequally yoked with unbelievers: for what fellowship have righteousness and iniquity? or what communion hath light with darkness?

entries.title: II Corinthians 6:15
segments: And what concord hath Christ with Belial? or what portion hath a believer with an unbeliever?

entries.title: II Corinthians 6:16
segments: And what agreement hath a temple of God with idols? for we are a temple of the living God; even as God said, I will dwell in them, and walk in them; and I will be their God, and they shall be my people.

entries.title: II Corinthians 6:17
segments: Wherefore Come ye out from among them, and be ye separate, saith the Lord, And touch no unclean thing; And I will receive you,

entries.title: II Corinthians 6:18
segments: And will be to you a Father, And ye shall be to me sons and daughters, saith the Lord Almighty.
